column1: # Crates that may contain `unsafe`, one row per crate.
# The gate `cargo xtask check unsafe-surface` fails when a crate outside this
# ledger contains its first `unsafe` block, and when a row here outlives the
# `unsafe` it was written for. The reason column names the FFI boundary the
# crate crosses, because that boundary is what the next reviewer has to check.
# Generated tree-sitter sources under `crates/grammars` are excluded from the
# Per-block `// SAFETY:` comments are a separate requirement (`.rules`). This
# ledger only answers "may this crate contain `unsafe` at all".
